practices.practice: Create one shared MongoClient per process (singleton) and reuse it across modules; do not create a new client per request.
practices.prior_belief: Use a single shared MongoClient instance (a singleton) created at app startup and reused across modules; do not open a new client per request. Close the client gracefully on shutdown.

practices.practice: Read the cluster connection URI and all credentials from environment variables or a secrets store and never commit credentials into source or logs.
practices.prior_belief: Read the cluster connection string and all credentials from environment variables (e.g., DOCUMENTDB_URI) or a config secret store; never commit credentials into source, logs, or seed files. Provide a .env.example with placeholders only.

practices.practice: Always use TLS for connections to Azure DocumentDB and do not disable certificate validation in production.
practices.prior_belief: Enforce TLS/SSL for connections and validate server certificates (enable TLS/ssl options in the driver and supply CA or system trust); do not disable certificate validation to avoid MITM risk.

practices.practice: Tune connection-pool and timeout settings to your environment: choose maxPoolSize/minPoolSize/connectTimeoutMS/socketTimeoutMS according to serverless vs long-running server scenarios and expected concurrency.
practices.prior_belief: Tune the MongoDB driver pool and timeouts for the managed cluster: set an appropriate maxPoolSize, serverSelectionTimeoutMS, socketTimeoutMS and heartbeatFrequencyMS to match the cluster size and client concurrency; document chosen values and rationale.

practices.practice: Use retries for transient errors with exponential backoff and classify errors so non-idempotent operations are not retried blindly; combine driver automatic retryable reads with application-level backoff where appropriate.
practices.prior_belief: Implement retries with exponential backoff for transient network errors and retryable server responses; limit retry count and classify errors so non-idempotent operations are not retried blindly.

practices.practice: Design compound indexes using the ESR rule (Equality → Sort → Range) so abandonment queries (filters + sort) are index-supported and avoid blocking in-memory sorts.
practices.prior_belief: Create an index on the cart abandonment timestamp field (e.g., abandonedAt or lastUpdated) and include any filter fields (status, channelPreference) as a compound index so the query 'abandoned > 2 hours AND status = X' is index-supported.

practices.practice: Use projections and covered queries to return only fields needed for orchestration to reduce network and memory usage; design covering indexes when appropriate.
practices.prior_belief: Use projections to return only the fields needed for orchestration (customer id, contact, preference, cart items, embedding) to reduce network usage and memory pressure.

practices.practice: Keep a small index budget per collection (review with $indexStats) and avoid creating many unused indexes; drop or hide unused indexes after verification.
Prefer the DocumentDB full-text search (`createSearchIndexes` + $search) and its textSearch indexes for lexical search rather than the community `$text` operator.
Enable diagnostic settings and slow-query logging, route logs to Log Analytics, and use explain("executionStats") to identify COLLSCANs and high docsExamined to guide index changes.
practices.prior_belief: Use the provider’s explain/monitoring tools (documentdb MCP server or explain() plans) to verify that the critical queries (abandoned cart search) use indexes and do not trigger full collection scans.

practices.practice: For vector search, choose the index type by scale: prefer DiskANN for large production corpora, HNSW for mid-scale, and IVF only for small datasets; declare dimensions and similarity and tune lBuild/lSearch parameters.
practices.prior_belief: For vector similarity, store embeddings as a fixed-dimension numeric array and create the appropriate vector index (DiskANN / HNSW / IVF) on the embedding field with tuned index params (e.g., M, efConstruction) appropriate for the data volume and latency targets.

practices.practice: Normalize embeddings at ingestion when using cosine similarity, store embedding model metadata and dims with the document, and validate dimensionality on writes.
practices.prior_belief: Normalize and persist the embedding dimensionality and datatype (e.g., float32, fixed length) and validate at write-time so vector index queries always receive consistent vectors.

practices.practice: Use HA (availability-zone enabled) for production clusters to get automatic in-region failover and the 99.99% SLA; add cross-region replica clusters when you need cross-region DR and a 99.995% SLA.
Premium SSD v2 decouples IOPS/bandwidth from disk size — size compute for throughput (IOPS) and storage for capacity; IOPS caps are gated by compute tier rather than disk size.
Do not index high-cardinality free-text fields by default; review index cardinality and prefer specialized text search or external search for heavy full-text workloads.
practices.prior_belief: Monitor index cardinality and avoid indexing high-cardinality free-text fields without need; prefer specialized text index or external search for heavy full‑text needs.

practices.practice: When performing vector similarity queries, limit topK and tune approximate search parameters (lSearch/ef) to control latency and resource usage, and combine vector search with pre-filters.
practices.prior_belief: When performing similarity queries, limit the search to a reasonable topK and use approximate search parameters (efSearch/ef) to control latency and RU consumption; evaluate recall vs cost.

practices.practice: Prefer least-privilege application users and Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC rather than embedding cluster-admin credentials in apps.
practices.prior_belief: Use least-privilege database users/roles for application access (create a user limited to the sample_retail_12 DB and to required operations) rather than a cluster admin connection string embedded in the app.

practices.practice: Make seed scripts idempotent — use upserts or existence checks rather than dropping collections so scripts are safe to run repeatedly.
practices.prior_belief: Seed scripts must be idempotent: use upserts or check-for-existence rather than dropping collections so the script is safe to run against the sample database repeatedly.

practices.practice: Use explain("executionStats") (or MCP explain_operation) and index stats to diagnose query performance and verify index effectiveness before and after changes.

Avoid creating a separate MongoClient per request in serverless functions: initialize the client outside the handler so it is reused across warm invocations and keep maxPoolSize small (3–5) for serverless instances.

Do not assume Cosmos DB throughput concepts (RU/s autoscale) map directly to Azure DocumentDB; instead, size compute tier for IOPS/throughput because IOPS are gated by compute (Premium SSD v2) rather than disk size.
practices.prior_belief: Provision adequate throughput for queries and bulk writes (use autoscale where available) and monitor RU/s (or equivalent) consumption; tune indices and batching to control cost.

practices.practice: Do not index a low-cardinality boolean alone expecting good selectivity; combine it in a compound index with a more-selective field so the index is useful for filtering.
